security_scope: OpenFHE classic128 parameter check; no claim of quantum128 or certified DFR; sampler approximation not newly certified
timing_scope: Public API including crypto sampling; excludes serialization, fixture creation, result destruction and correctness checks
randomness: Unmodified OpenFHE PRNG; no fixed crypto seeds
message_validation: All N coefficients checked modulo 2 after every measured and warmup Enc/ReEnc and Decrypt: first 256 equal the message, remaining N-256 are zero padding; checks outside timing

serialization.standalone_scope: Fresh archive per object: includes embedded shared context, polynomial params, key tag and metadata
serialization.incremental_scope: Additional object bytes after context in one shared archive; pointer deduplication, not a standalone context-free wire format
